top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not been documenting their monthly maintenance inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined caregiver does not have high school diploma or high school equivalent certificate.

top_violation_types.title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff stated that the permit holder is aware of the physical state that the classroom walls and floors are in. They stated that they are no longer accredited as a result and that work orders have been put in, but no repairs have been completed.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.
